title: P4 Candidate Funnel and Turnover-Risk Contract Diagnostic

research_height.transfer_path: The component-level passed-candidate and admission reasons are traced through durable first fills into the portfolio-level three-fills-per-normal-day obligation. No blocked candidate is assigned a counterfactual close outcome.

central_question: Does the actual P4 causal candidate funnel show that the current planned-risk aggregate-cap contract is a material bottleneck to the official three-lifecycle-starting-first-fills-per-normal-day obligation, or is most attrition upstream and the observed risk block too sparse or concentrated to justify a risk-accounting counterfactual?

research_bundle.name: candidate_funnel_and_turnover_risk_contract
lenses: aggregate-risk blocker mechanism and occupied-slot shape
favorable direct-release upper bound against the daily turnover obligation

why_now.current_bottleneck: The frozen non-interfering P4 candidate ledger is the first authoritative Next artifact that records passed-but-blocked admission reasons together with pre-decision aggregate risk, headroom, slots, symbol book and component identity.
why_now.connection_bridge: The proposal connects explicit missed admissions to the existing portfolio turnover obligation and to actual lot, slot and aggregate-risk implementation decisions.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 060 was a Program 4 meso post-entry hold intervention. Unit 061 moves to Program 5 macro pre-entry portfolio admission and uses an already-consumed causal ledger rather than fresh Tester intervention.
why_now.difference_from_prior_units: Unit 054 tested loss co-occurrence, Unit 037 tested ex-post occupancy value, Unit 056 tested entry handoff state and Unit 059 tested signal-state value. None reconstructed the full candidate funnel or measured whether aggregate-risk blocks can materially bridge the fixed daily first-fill obligation.
why_now.external_memo_scope: This unit combines only the structurally inseparable blocked-opportunity funnel and turnover-risk-contract proposals. Market-defined stop-to-lot sizing, all-slot evaluation clocks and Cross beta decomposition remain unopened and require separate whole-map comparisons.

decision_translation.if_true: Retain exactly one later, separately declared planned-versus-actual open-risk accounting counterfactual after a whole-map comparison. Unit 061 itself changes no risk cap, lot, slot, priority, admission or Live behavior.
decision_translation.if_false: Close the full-funnel and turnover-risk-contract expansion, preserve the current planned-risk admission contract and do not implement or simulate a risk-accounting relaxation from these P4 blockers.
decision_translation.if_ambiguous: Record the observation gap without selecting a policy or automatically expanding the logger.

lifecycle_ledger.allowed_role: BIRTH rows only; CLOSE and FIRST_PEER_NATURAL_EXIT economics are excluded

data_role.role: consumed exploratory mechanism, funnel and turnover-bound evidence
data_role.authority_limit: Even a pass retains only one later counterfactual question; P4 alone cannot select a risk, lot or slot policy.

pre_metric_feasibility.scope: Only immutable identities, headers, terminal candidate stage/result, signal-known/pass flags, admission reason, component, symbol, server date and BIRTH structural identity were inspected. No blocker slot distribution, risk excess, headroom aggregate, daily birth-compliance metric, materiality gate, CLOSE economic field or verdict was calculated.

fixed_reconstruction.terminal_row_contract: Each of the 4,043 candidate rows is one terminal result for a scheduled strategy evaluation. Count each row once and do not infer an unlogged signal behind signal_known=0 occupancy short circuits.
fixed_reconstruction.candidate_to_birth_key: Exact CSV strings component_id + volume + stop_loss + planned_risk_usd + signal_relation, identical to the already-authoritative Unit 059 reconstruction. Every BIRTH must match one admitted candidate, with 27 unmatched Passive pending orders, zero unmatched BIRTH and zero ambiguity.
fixed_reconstruction.normal_day_denominator: The exact 165 distinct server calendar dates present in the terminal candidate ledger. Every date remains in the denominator, including dates with zero passed signal or zero BIRTH; no date outside this frozen P4 logger set is inferred.
fixed_reconstruction.turnover_obligation: Three lifecycle-starting first fills on every frozen normal candidate date. Aggregate required births are 3 times 165, but aggregate count alone cannot pass the per-day obligation.
fixed_reconstruction.baseline_daily_births: Count BIRTH rows by actual entry_time_server date over the complete 165-date denominator, inserting zero for dates without a BIRTH.
fixed_reconstruction.favorable_direct_risk_release: Add one hypothetical same-date first fill for each of the 14 aggregate-risk-blocked candidate rows, without assigning future P/L and without modeling downstream displacement. This is an intentionally favorable gross direct-release upper bound, not a realizable simulation.
fixed_reconstruction.favorable_all_post_pass_release: As context only, also add all 15 post-pass blockers. It cannot enter or rescue the material risk-contract gate.
fixed_reconstruction.occupied_slots_before: Parse active_slots and reserved_slots as nonnegative integers and report both. Combined occupied slots equal active_slots plus reserved_slots.
fixed_reconstruction.risk_excess_usd: attempted_aggregate_after_usd minus aggregate_cap_usd for each aggregate-risk blocker.
fixed_reconstruction.zero_headroom: aggregate_headroom_usd parsed as decimal equals exactly zero.
fixed_reconstruction.no_counterfactual_economics: Do not access CLOSE actual_net_usd, stressed_net_usd, exit class, mark path or any blocked-candidate future value.

fixed_reports.funnel: Report exact count and conditional conversion rate at every frozen funnel step plus all terminal reasons.
fixed_reports.blocker_topology: Report the 14 aggregate-risk blockers and one distance blocker as shares of passed signals and durable births, by component, symbol and month.
fixed_reports.contract_shape: For the 14 risk blockers report active, reserved and combined occupied-slot distributions; aggregate risk before, cap and headroom; attempted planned risk; attempted aggregate after; risk excess; median and maximum excess fraction; zero-headroom count; and the share blocked below three combined occupied slots.
fixed_reports.turnover_bound: Report baseline average births per frozen day, aggregate gap to 495, days meeting at least three births, favorable direct-risk-release births/gap coverage/compliant-day change, and the all-15 context bound.
fixed_reports.causal_limit: State explicitly that existing-exposure rows are not known lost signals and blocked candidates have no outcome dollars.

fixed_integrity_gate: All three immutable inputs retain their exact byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes and the logger result retains the required non-interference verdict.
The candidate ledger reproduces 48 columns, 4,043 rows, 4,043 unique record_id values and zero nonzero research_dropped_records.

The lifecycle ledger reproduces 60 columns, 841 rows, 841 unique record_id values, events 356 BIRTH / 356 CLOSE / 129 FIRST_PEER_NATURAL_EXIT and zero nonzero research_dropped_records; only BIRTH rows are selected for Unit 061 metrics.
Reproduce every declared stage/result, signal, admission, birth, pending-expiration, date, blocker component, symbol and month count.
The exact candidate-to-birth key yields 356 unique matches, 27 unmatched expired Passive pending orders, zero unmatched BIRTH and zero ambiguity.

All 14 aggregate-risk blockers have finite attempted_planned_risk_usd, attempted_aggregate_after_usd, aggregate_risk_before_usd, aggregate_cap_usd, aggregate_headroom_usd, active_slots and reserved_slots; aggregate_cap_usd is positive.
No CLOSE economic field is selected, cast, aggregated or emitted.
fixed_density_gate: There are at least ten aggregate-risk blockers.
Aggregate-risk blockers span at least four of six components, both natural symbol books and at least four server months.

fixed_mechanism_gate.cap_binding: All 14 PROTECTION_OR_RISK_BLOCKED rows have admission_reason exactly AGGREGATE_RISK_CAP and attempted_aggregate_after_usd strictly greater than aggregate_cap_usd.
fixed_mechanism_gate.subthree_accounting_shape: At least 25 percent of the 14 risk blockers occur with active_slots plus reserved_slots below three.
fixed_mechanism_gate.interpretation: The sub-three condition distinguishes a planned-risk/minimum-lot or headroom arithmetic shape from risk blocking that occurs only after all three portfolio slots are already occupied.

fixed_material_turnover_risk_gate.breadth: at least four of six components, both natural books and at least four months
fixed_material_turnover_risk_gate.concentration: no component contributes more than 0.50 of the 14 risk blockers

fixed_verdict_rules.success: PASS_MATERIAL_TURNOVER_RISK_CONTRACT_BOTTLENECK_RETAIN_LATER_COUNTERFACTUAL when integrity, density, both mechanism conditions and every material turnover-risk condition pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.binding_but_not_material: CAP_BINDING_PRESENT_BUT_NO_MATERIAL_TURNOVER_BRIDGE when integrity and density pass, cap binding is reproduced, but the sub-three accounting shape or any material turnover-risk condition fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_mechanism: NO_TURNOVER_RISK_CONTRACT_BOTTLENECK when integrity and density pass but aggregate-cap binding is not reproduced.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_CANDIDATE_FUNNEL_OR_RISK_CONTRACT_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any immutable pin, schema, row identity, declared topology, join, finite-field or no-CLOSE-access condition fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_CANDIDATE_FUNNEL_TURNOVER_RISK_CONTRACT_NO_SEED only when integrity passes but an unforeseen semantic condition blocks the frozen interpretation without changing it.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before calculating blocker slot distributions, risk excess/headroom aggregates, daily birth compliance, favorable-release bounds, gate values or the Unit 061 verdict.
Run exactly one fixed in-memory aggregation over the two pinned ledgers and use only lifecycle BIRTH rows.

Do not reinterpret existing-exposure short circuits as signals, impute any blocked-candidate outcome, access CLOSE economics, introduce a threshold/window/subgroup rescue or add an alternate risk-cap scenario.
Do not implement actual-risk accounting, change the 12-percent aggregate cap, lot, slot, priority, admission, stop, entry or exit behavior in this unit.
Do not modify MQL, compile, run MetaTrader, retain a CLI, inspect Program 6, query broker/account state or touch Live.
Close after one result and recompare the complete Program 1-5 and 7 map before opening any remaining external-memo proposal.
